description: GraphML conformance corpus: the GraphML primer, library test suites (graphology, TinkerPop, Boost, igraph, OGDF, Gephi, Cytoscape, GraphStream, Tulip), real exporters (yEd, yFiles for HTML, graph-tool, Gephi, networkx, APOC), graphdrawing.org North samples, and authored XML-layer cases (encodings, entity attacks, malformed input).

fixtures.exercises: primer: minimal undirected graph
primer: typed keys with defaults
primer: key with nested default markup (extension)
primer: nested graphs, edges across levels (networkx 3.1 loses nested nodes, so the counts come from the document); inner edgedefaults differ, so the graph is mixed
primer: ports, sourceport/targetport, a hyperedge
primer: three hyperedges plus one edge; hyperedges skipped by default
primer: untyped keys holding SVG markup (extension)
graphology: basic undirected graph
graphology: typed attributes with defaults
graphology: Gephi-written les miserables with viz keys
graphology: data for undeclared keys (label, modularity_class) must be kept with a warning
fixtures.knownFailure: <data> for an undeclared key is an error and its value is dropped (sources.md 2.4)

fixtures.exercises: graphology: edges to undeclared nodes (addMissingNodes)
